I have updated config.py to add environment variable interpolation with the following:

- Added optional env argument to parse() defaulting to os.environ.
- Added _interpolate_value() function using regex for ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} syntax.
- Raises ConfigError if an env var is missing and no default is provided.
- Handles escape sequence $${ to produce literal ${.
- Interpolation only applies to values before storing in section.

Next, I will test this with some test cases to verify all requirements, including:
- Simple interpolation of set variable.
- Missing variable triggers ConfigError.
- Default value usage.
- Escape sequence produces literal ${.
- Quoted values are interpolated.
- Interpolation only affects values, not keys or comments.

I will write a small test code snippet to call parse() with sample input and custom env.
